record.stem: Furnizorul de energie electrică este îndreptăţit sã rezilieze contractul de furnizare a energiei electrice  în caz de:

options_original.A: sustragerea de energie electrică constatată prin hotărâre judecătorească definitivă
options_original.B: racordare ilegală la reţeaua de distribuţie
options_original.C: refuz al clientului final de a constitui garanţia solicitată de furnizor atunci când acesta constată acţiuni menite să denatureze în orice fel indicaţiile echipamentelor de măsurare

record.legal_article: Art.18(3)(a)-(c), Art.18(4)-(5), Art.26(2)(a)-(b) of ANRE supply regulation (Ord.5/2023), amended and consolidated official Portal Legislativ
record.option_A: Explicit *affirmative source-supported* termination because electricity theft was confirmed by final judgment; legal Art18(3)(a) directly matches original wording.
record.option_B: Illegal grid connection alone is NOT enumerated verbatim in Art18(3)(a), and need not establish a judicial conviction. It might fall under Art18(3)(c) 'other situations provided by law', which must be proven with a specific other legal provision. Current imported B not authenticated by source in audit.
record.option_C: Refusal of a requested financial guarantee permits electricity supply INTERRUPTION under Art26(2)(b); termination Art18 and physical interruption Art26 are distinct regulated legal actions. C is not demonstrated as a generic termination ground without an independently established legal provision.
record.inference: A has direct affirmative same-action statutory support. B is not categorically proven false, but cannot be validated or uniquely scored from article 18 alone. Keep unresolved until competent legal and linguistic independent review plus official historical scoring provenance.
record.anti_confusion: G1-LEG-002 QABC-0266 imported B is another source-original variant that correctly explicitly states court-confirmed theft in its B position; G1-LEG-017 source A has that same concept but imported B instead. Do not copy letters or auto-fix.
